title: Aquarium presentation
description: Aquarium room camera, lighting, and tank presentation settings.

groups.label: Room camera
groups.description: Choose a tested room camera, then tune the close framing values if needed.

buildingPresentation.camera.preset.label: Camera preset
buildingPresentation.camera.preset.description: Close integer 2x uses the tuned enlarged view. Overworld low keeps the exterior distance at a lower angle. Overworld uses the exterior camera unchanged.

buildingPresentation.camera.zoomedInEnab.label: Use aquarium camera
buildingPresentation.camera.zoomedInEnab.description: Turn this off to force the normal overworld camera regardless of the selected preset.

buildingPresentation.camera.distanceBehi.label: Close camera distance
buildingPresentation.camera.distanceBehi.description: Horizontal component used only by the Close integer 2x preset.

buildingPresentation.camera.heightAboveP.label: Close camera height
buildingPresentation.camera.heightAboveP.description: Vertical component used only by the Close integer 2x preset.

buildingPresentation.camera.overworldLow.label: Low camera pitch
buildingPresentation.camera.overworldLow.description: Controls only the Overworld distance, low preset. Values nearer zero place the camera lower to the ground.
